lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in organized vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, transitioning to a dense, stochastic distribution toward the cranial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct reddish-brown circular patch is visible on the posterior flank, indicative of a localized lesion or skin anomaly.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small commensal fish (likely remoras) are visible in the water column near the pectoral fin and ventral surface.
